stations.title: Abnormal CTG on the birth suite
stations.desc: This station involves the immediate management of an abnormal CTG during an oxytocin induction that is complicated by umbilical cord prolapse, followed by examiner questions on fetal position, the cardinal movements of labour and how to talk to a woman during shoulder dystocia.
stations.focus: Intrapartum obstetric emergency: shoulder dystocia, cord prolapse and abnormal CTG in labour

stations.title: Assault with neck laceration and nasal injury
stations.desc: This station involves a trauma primary survey with immediate management of a superficial neck wound over the external jugular vein, followed by a focused history, a nasal examination and counselling for a nasal septal haematoma.
stations.focus: Trauma primary survey in the ED: neck and nasal injuries

stations.title: Baby not breathing at birth
stations.desc: This station involves leading the resuscitation of a term baby who is apnoeic at birth, interpreting SpO2 targets, cord gas and blood glucose, and explaining the assessment, disposition and return advice to the mother.
stations.focus: Neonatal resuscitation of a baby who is not breathing at birth

stations.title: Boggy uterus after a big baby
stations.desc: This station involves the emergency management of an atonic postpartum haemorrhage on the labour ward, including consented bimanual compression, communication with the partner and recognition of retained placental tissue.
stations.focus: Atonic postpartum haemorrhage on the labour ward

stations.title: Chest pain, fever and breathlessness after a bereavement
stations.desc: This station involves assessing an acutely unwell older woman with chest pain, breathlessness and fever, risk stratifying for STEMI, pneumonia and pulmonary embolism, and recognising where Takotsubo cardiomyopathy fits as a differential.
stations.focus: Acute chest pain and breathlessness: risk stratifying PE, pneumonia and Takotsubo

stations.title: Heart health check: raised clinic blood pressure
stations.desc: This station involves a heart health check in which the candidate takes a focused cardiovascular history, counsels on raised clinic blood pressure with normal home readings, and writes a three-month statin prescription.
stations.focus: Heart health check: cardiovascular prevention, hypertension, diet and prescribing

stations.title: High-chance NIPT result for a rare autosomal trisomy
stations.desc: This station involves counselling a pregnant woman about a high-chance NIPT result for a rare autosomal trisomy, explaining why it is not diagnostic, advising on confirmatory testing and answering her question about a relative's failed NIPT.
diagnosis: Differential: true fetal rare autosomal trisomy vs confined placental mosaicism / false-positive NIPT result
stations.focus: Counselling after a high-risk NIPT result

stations.title: Infant with increased work of breathing
stations.desc: This station involves assessing and managing an infant with bronchiolitis, hypoxaemia and poor feeding in the Emergency Department, then explaining the plan to their parent.
stations.focus: Bronchiolitis in an infant with increased work of breathing

stations.title: Newly Diagnosed HIV: Explaining the Virus and ART
stations.desc: This station involves explaining a new HIV diagnosis to a young man, including how HIV causes disease, how it enters cells, and what antiretroviral therapy can and cannot achieve.
presentation: Patient questions about HIV and treatment
stations.focus: Newly diagnosed HIV: explaining the virus and what ART achieves

stations.title: Non-lactational breast abscess
stations.desc: This station involves taking a focused history from a woman with a red, painful breast lump who is not breastfeeding, planning her work-up and management, and counselling her about why imaging and biopsy are needed as well as treating the infection.
stations.focus: Breast lump and breast abscess work-up

stations.title: Pale stools and a bleeding cord stump in a jaundiced 18-day-old
stations.desc: This station involves taking a focused history from the parent of an 18-day-old with prolonged jaundice, pale stools and an earlier cord-stump bleed after vitamin K was declined, then arranging same-day urgent assessment and counselling on vitamin K, the two-vessel cord, hips and safe sleep.
stations.focus: Newborn check and parent counselling: vitamin K, hips, jaundice, safe sleep

stations.title: Persistent cough in a toddler not responding to treatment
stations.desc: This station involves taking a focused history from the parent of a toddler with a five-week cough that has not responded to antibiotics, steroids or bronchodilators, interpreting a chest X-ray showing focal lung collapse, explaining the plan, and answering examiner questions about airway infections including retropharyngeal abscess.
stations.focus: Toddler with persistent cough and airway infection

stations.title: Pre-biologic screening: an abnormal hepatitis B result in Crohn's disease
stations.desc: This station involves taking a focussed pre-immunosuppression risk history and counselling a young man with Crohn's disease about a positive hepatitis B screening result, faecal calprotectin and the choice of advanced therapy.
stations.focus: Counselling before starting advanced therapy for IBD

stations.title: Pre-travel consultation: vaccines and travel health
stations.desc: This station involves taking a focused pre-travel history from a young adult planning a long rural trip through mainland Asia, interpreting their immunisation record, and counselling on risk-based vaccines, malaria prevention, food and water safety and return-fever safety-netting.
stations.focus: Pre-travel consultation: vaccines and travel health

stations.title: Primary postpartum haemorrhage on delivery suite
stations.desc: This station involves leading the assessment, resuscitation and escalation of a primary postpartum haemorrhage from uterine atony, interpreting blood results, and explaining the plan, disposition and safety-netting to the patient at the bedside.
stations.focus: Primary postpartum haemorrhage

stations.title: Projectile vomiting in a 5-week-old infant
stations.desc: This station involves assessing a dehydrated infant with vomiting, interpreting the metabolic alkalosis of pyloric stenosis, starting fluid resuscitation and explaining the plan to the mother.
stations.focus: Pyloric stenosis: a vomiting infant, dehydration and the metabolic alkalosis

stations.title: Prostate biopsy result: grading and staging
stations.desc: This station involves counselling a man about his prostate biopsy result, explaining Gleason score and ISUP Grade Group, and outlining staging with PSMA PET/CT.
stations.focus: Counselling a man with a raised PSA: biopsy, Gleason/ISUP grading and staging

stations.title: Reduced movements and worry after a previous stillbirth
stations.desc: This station involves assessing a woman at 36 weeks with reduced fetal movements and a normal CTG, explaining the result honestly, supporting her anxiety after a previous stillbirth, and answering her questions about food safety, aspirin and later health risks.
diagnosis: Reduced fetal movements with normal cardiotocograph
stations.focus: Antenatal visit: food advice, reduced fetal movements, anxiety after stillbirth and later health risks

stations.title: Right upper quadrant pain with vomiting in an older woman
stations.desc: This station involves taking a focused history from an older woman with right upper quadrant pain and vomiting, interpreting her abdominal X-ray, explaining why this is not cholecystitis or cholangitis, and counselling her about the diagnosis and initial plan.
stations.focus: Acute right upper quadrant pain with suspected cholecystitis, cholangitis or gallstone ileus

stations.title: Severe abdominal pain after curettage for abnormal bleeding
stations.desc: This station involves assessing and resuscitating a woman who deteriorates in day-surgery recovery after a dilatation and curettage, escalating for suspected uterine perforation, and then explaining the PALM-COEIN classification and why obesity raises endometrial cancer risk.
stations.focus: Abnormal uterine bleeding assessment

stations.title: Simple febrile seizure
stations.desc: This station involves assessing a toddler who has had a first brief generalised seizure with fever, requesting and interpreting appropriate investigations, and counselling the parents on recurrence, seizure first aid, discharge and return advice.
stations.focus: A simple febrile seizure: assessment, the parents' questions, discharge and first aid

stations.title: Sudden aggression in a boy with intellectual disability
stations.desc: This station involves taking a history from the carer of a child with intellectual disability and acute behavioural change, and explaining to the examiner the approach to assessment and management.
stations.focus: Child with intellectual disability and behavioural change

stations.title: Sudden hearing loss in one ear on waking
stations.desc: This station involves taking a focused history from a patient with sudden hearing loss in one ear, interpreting bedside findings, and explaining the urgent investigations (including why an MRI is needed) and initial steroid treatment.
stations.focus: Sudden hearing loss

stations.title: Toddler with stridor: croup
stations.desc: This station involves a focused history from the mother and a gentle examination of a 2-year-old with a barking cough and stridor, then interpreting the observations on arrival and on reassessment, classifying the croup, outlining management with weight-based doses, and safety-netting the mother.
stations.focus: Croup in a toddler with stridor

stations.title: Turner syndrome: short stature and delayed puberty
stations.desc: This station involves taking a history from the mother of a 13-year-old girl with short stature and absent puberty, requesting and interpreting investigations for suspected Turner syndrome, and counselling the mother about the diagnosis and management plan.
stations.focus: Turner syndrome: short stature and delayed puberty in a girl

stations.title: Unwell newborn with suspected early-onset sepsis
stations.desc: This station involves stabilising a 14-hour-old term neonate with suspected early-onset sepsis and shock, interpreting the initial investigations, and explaining the plan to the mother.
stations.focus: Suspected early-onset neonatal sepsis
